numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Setting a NA-free nullable or ArrowDtype extension array into an incompatible NumPy-dtype column silently stores wrong values: a negative value into an unsigned-integer column wraps (-1 becomes 18446744073709551615), and a float value overflowing a narrower target float dtype becomes inf (1e300 becomes inf).
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The assignment must raise instead of silently wrapping or overflowing, while a fitting value still assigns inplace.
trigger_conditions: setitem via a user-facing path such as Series.iloc or arr[[0]] = ... (the TST commit tests iloc setitem)
value is an NA-free signed nullable EA (Int64) or int64[pyarrow] holding a negative value, assigned into an unsigned-integer NumPy-dtype column
value is an NA-free Float64 or double[pyarrow] EA whose value overflows a narrower target float dtype
before the fix, np_can_hold_element returned the element after only checking for NAs on the nullable/arrow EA branches

category_specific_evidence: Correctness violation: a NA-free signed EA value (-1) assigned into a uint64 column silently wraps to 2**64-1 (18446744073709551615) instead of raising
Correctness violation: a Float64/double[pyarrow] value 1e300 assigned into a float32 column silently becomes inf instead of raising
Scalar setitem reference behavior: arr[[0]] = [1000] on Int8 silently wrapped instead of raising (GH#45404)
Test test_iloc_setitem_ea_dtype_lossy_raises expects TypeError matching 'Invalid value' for lossy assignment and in-place assignment retaining dtype for fitting values (e.g. 5 and 5.0)
Test test_can_hold_element_ea_no_na_lossy_values asserts can_hold_element is True for fitting values [1,2,3] and [1.0,2.0], and False for [-1,2,3] into uint64 and [1e300,2.0] into float32
Root cause: np_can_hold_element nullable/arrow EA branches checked only for NAs and skipped value-fit guards; fix re-runs ndarray guards on NA-free values via np.asarray
Float-overflow astype in ndarray branch wrapped in np.errstate(over='ignore') because the cast is used only for the losslessness check
